title: Cipher Benchmark Record
description: Schema for a single page-level benchmark record in the classical cipher benchmark

source_record_id.description: Identifier in the original source system

source_url.description: URL to the source record or project page

task_tracks.description: Which benchmark tracks this record supports

rights_class.description: Whether the record can be redistributed or must be linked

symbol_count.description: Number of distinct cipher symbols on this page

plaintext_language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the plaintext

date_or_century.description: Date or approximate period of the original document (free text, e.g. '1582' or '16c')

date_earliest_year.description: Earliest plausible year (inclusive) for the record's original composition. Optional; populated when date_or_century yields a parseable lower bound.

date_latest_year.description: Latest plausible year (inclusive). Optional; populated when date_or_century yields a parseable upper bound.

image_provenance.description: Structured record of where and how the page image was fetched. Populate for records whose images come from a live archive (IIIF, HTTP). Parallel to the same field in the unsolved schema.

offset_source.description: Path/reference to the offset table used (e.g. 'data_staging/gallica_folio_offsets.json')

page_count.description: Number of pages in this record (always 1 for page-level records)

solution_reference.description: Citation for the decipherment or solution

image_files.description: Relative paths to page image files. Required for image2transcription and image2plaintext records; omitted for Track-B-only generated records.

transcription_diplomatic_file.description: Relative path to the diplomatic transcription file

transcription_canonical_file.description: Relative path to the canonical transcription file

plaintext_file.description: Relative path to the plaintext/decryption file

has_key.description: Whether the cipher key is known

has_inline_plaintext.description: Whether the document contains mixed cipher and cleartext

synthetic.description: True if this record was generated programmatically rather than drawn from a historical manuscript. Consumers aggregating performance statistics should partition on this field.

generation_config.description: For synthetic records, captures the generator identity and parameters needed to reproduce. Omitted for historical records.

manuscript_page.description: Original manuscript page or folio identifier. Always a string: numbered pages serialize as e.g. "42"; folio notation uses e.g. "f3r" or "0001r".

word_boundaries.description: Whether the canonical transcription preserves plaintext word boundaries.

token_count.description: Number of cipher tokens in the canonical transcription.

word_count.description: Approximate number of plaintext words represented by the record.

context_layers.description: Tiered, solver-facing context blocks. Runners may select one or more layers to test blind, minimal, standard, or stronger context-aware solving. Context text must not include ground-truth plaintext unless contains_solution is true.

source_fields.description: Manifest or metadata fields used to build this context layer.

related_record_ids.description: Related record IDs referenced by this layer.

related_records.description: Related benchmark records that may optionally be exposed to a solver under an explicit context policy.

safe_context_layers.description: Context policies/layers under which this relationship may be exposed.

associated_documents.description: Long-form or auxiliary documents associated with this record, such as accompanying plaintext letters, envelopes, notes, newspaper clippings, or source commentary. Store concise summaries in context_layers; expose full text/images only through explicit context policies or agent tools.

allOf.$comment: S4: non-synthetic records must carry at least one source pointer.
